sections.title: Diversity and form
sections.text: Erica is a genus of heathers with several hundred species, mostly shrubs of heathland and other open habitats. Most stay under 1 m, while some, such as E. arborea, exceed 5 m.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Leaves are generally small and narrow; flowers across the genus are often bell- or tube-shaped. Colour and flowering season vary widely among species; the plate shows a pink-flowered heath with an appearance close to E. cinerea.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: Because the genus is diverse, no single edibility or toxicity statement applies to all its species.
